task_reconstruction.official_task: 2023 MCM Problem C, Wordle: the report count, the hard-mode share, the try distribution, and word difficulty.
required_outputs: a prediction interval for the number of reported results on March 1, 2023
a decision on whether word attributes change the hard-mode share
a letter to the puzzle editor

writing_logic.summary: The ARIMA model is praised and then charged with two costs.
Each weight is defined as the other model's share of the error.
The direct route is refused before the transform is named.
One indicator is called more decisive, and the ordering follows it.

contributions.summary: The report count is given a point of about 19944 and three intervals.
Only the initial letter and the word internal distance move the hard-mode share.
EERIE is given seven try shares.
EERIE is placed in difficulty level III.

models.summary: MU-C-Q259-001: an autoregressive model with one difference and no moving-average term
MU-C-Q259-002: a weighted average of two forecasts, with a bootstrap interval
MU-C-Q259-003: a multiple linear regression on seven word attributes
MU-C-Q259-004: a long short-term memory network on a transformed share vector
MU-C-Q259-005: a Gaussian mixture clustering on six difficulty indicators

dependency_graph.label: The ARIMA point forecast is one of the two points the weighting combines.
The combined player count, about 19944, is an input of the LSTM.
The seven word attributes defined for the regression are the other inputs of the LSTM.
The same word attributes feed the objective difficulty indicators.
The try shares that the LSTM predicts are the raw material of the subjective indicators.

assumptions.summary: The daily gamer count is a time-dependent series independent of seasonal changes.
The scores reported on Twitter are normal and reliable.
Wordle's development is consistent with the game's life cycle theory.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: No missing values, and five outliers: three rows deleted and two repaired.
The percentage sums lie in [98%, 102%] and are left unprocessed.
The prose counts 356 words and the caption of Figure 9 counts 357.

results_trace.summary: The combined point forecast is approximately 19944.
The 95 percent interval is (19,504.74, 20,383.26), and it is a decrease.
EERIE is predicted as 2, 11, 25, 24, 19, 14, and 5 percent.
EERIE belongs to difficulty level III, by the printed Marxist distance.

verification.summary: The model is significant at the 10 percent level, with p of 0.097.
The uncertainty is 0.4321 from the parameters and 0.4794 from the noise.
The average MAE is 4.062, the average RMSE 5.339, and the R2 0.978.
The silhouette values of the five levels all lie near 0.8.

weaknesses.summary: The summary prints a letter to the the Puzzle Editor, and promises MSE where the body computes MAE.
The prose calls an autoregressive coefficient the coefficient of the moving self-averaging polynomial.
Equation (2) prints the square root of a variance on the left of a sample standard deviation.
The prose says 356 words and the caption of Figure 9 says 357.
The body prints the ROC of words where it means the RDC, and prints the Marxist distance.
The letter is dated Feburary 20th and starts the data on January 31, while the body starts on January 7.
Reference [1] prints Match, S., and reference [7] prints in tervals.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The paper reports a contrast it found and then admits it did not explore it, which is a result a team might rather omit.
The model is called significant at a p-value of 0.097, so the reader has to notice the 10 percent level.

independent_extensions.summary: Rewrite the standard deviation so the left side matches the sample formula on the right.
Recover the four LSTM gate formulas from a rendering, since the text layer drops them.

unresolved_questions: Why does the summary promise MSE, RMSE, and R2 in Table 7, when section 5.4 and Table 7 use MAE, RMSE, and R2?
Why does the letter start the data on January 31, 2022, when the body says January 7?
Why does the caption of Figure 9 count 357 words when the prose counts 356?
Why does equation (2) print the square root of a variance on the left of a sample standard deviation?
Why does the body print Marxist distance for the placement of EERIE, and ROC for the relative difficulty coefficient?
Why does the letter say the guesses range from one to more than seven, when the body uses seven categories?

candidate_rule_impacts.summary: Weight each model by the other model's error, and say so.
Report the finding that was not explored, and attach the limit.
